limits: The pre-write cleanliness of the working tree is a recorded measurement of an earlier phase and is not re-derivable from the repository alone. Its corroboration is the tracked diff against the baseline, which contains only this work package's evidence paths.

Remote-tracking ref origin/main is a local mirror and does not prove the current server state. A remote statement requires a read-only git ls-remote with network access and is made only with the remote-state scan before release.
Three pre-existing stash entries and ignored build and evidence outputs of earlier work packages are present in the working repository, are not part of the baseline tree and are left untouched.

revisionNote: Revision 2 corrects revision 1 under lead directive DIR-RECOVERY-FIRST-BLOCK-001. Revision 1 reported a single working-tree cleanliness number that mixed the proven pre-write state with the expected generation-time state, and its combined assertionsAllTrue flag could be read as an unmodelled cleanliness claim. Cleanliness is now modelled per phase and separated from the ancestry assertions. Commit 547f98f4 is not rewritten.

scopedResults.note: There is deliberately no combined all-true flag. Ancestry and cleanliness are separate claims with different re-measurability, and a single flag would let the historical cleanliness record be read as a currently proven property.
